profile.name: DMG-CPU-B
profile.applicability: Original software continuation fixture for the deterministic bootless DMG-CPU-B profile; not physical hardware evidence.

protocol.store_branch: When bank 0 0xA000-0xA002 is not 0x47 0x42 0x35 ('GB5') with 0xA003 = 0x00, or bank 15 0xA000-0xA003 is not 'GB5' 0x0F, the guest enables RAM (0x0A to 0x0000), writes 'G','B','5',0x00 at bank 0 0xA000 and 'G','B','5',0x0F at bank 15 0xA000 (bank selected through 0x4000), and publishes WRAM C000=0x01.
protocol.resume_branch: When both four-byte markers are intact, the guest sets WRAM C001=0xA5 and publishes C000=0x02.
protocol.missing_save: fresh RAM reads 0xFF, so the store branch runs and C000=0x01; a missing or rejected save is observable as C000=0x01, never as a resume
protocol.ram_size_note: 128 KiB cartridge RAM (16 banks) exercises the maximum save envelope v2 payload size.
protocol.evidence: Distinct fresh instances or processes observe the stored markers in two widely separated RAM banks; this is software continuation evidence only.

scope_limits: No rumble or MBC5 ROM-bank behavior claim
No BGB footer or other emulator save-format claim
The guest protocol tests file-backed continuation separately from mapper/API correctness
